## 1. Receive the post & prepare
Called by **Auto-post** after a successful Fanpage post (real post, not test mode). Splits title, description and body for each channel.
Channels already marked **[OA✓]** / **[GMF✓]** in Notes are skipped (no double posting).

## 2. Zalo OA – article
OA cover: use the **16:9 landscape image** (column Ảnh bìa OA, set by /datanh, /dunganh or /anhbia). If missing, place the square image in the middle on a blurred background; if that fails too, use the original image.
Publish the article on the OA. On error wait 60 seconds and **retry once**. Needs the **Manage articles** permission.
AI places extra images under the matching numbered point; `[ảnh N]` lines in the post put image N exactly there.

## 3. GMF Zalo group
Upload the post images to Zalo → send a numbered grid image + post + Fanpage link to the group, with a summary. A failed message is **resent once** after 30 seconds.

## 4. Save results & alert errors
Notes: successful channels get [OA✓] [GMF✓], failed channels get the reason. Still failing after retry → alert to Zalo (Error alert workflow).
